value="<b>Choosing a victim on a miss</b>: follow the bits from the root. b0 = 0 picks the left pair (then b1 picks way 0 or 1); b0 = 1 picks the right pair (then b2 picks way 2 or 3).<br><br><b>Updating on a hit to way w</b>: make the bits point <i>away</i> from w.<br>b0 &#8592; not w[1]<br>if w[1] = 1: b2 &#8592; not w[0], else b1 &#8592; not w[0]<br><br>Only hits update the tree. A miss fills the victim and returns to IDLE, where the repeated request hits and updates the tree then." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="250" width="570" x="620" y="470" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
Choosing a victim on a miss: follow the bits from the root. b0 = 0 picks the left pair (then b1 picks way 0 or 1); b0 = 1 picks the right pair (then b2 picks way 2 or 3).
Updating on a hit to way w: make the bits point away from w.
b0 ← not w[1]
if w[1] = 1: b2 ← not w[0], else b1 ← not w[0]
Only hits update the tree. A miss fills the victim and returns to IDLE, where the repeated request hits and updates the tree then.

text.tspan: Choosing a victim on a miss: follow the bits from the root. b0 = 0 picks the left pair (then b1
picks way 0 or 1); b0 = 1 picks the right pair (then b2 picks way 2 or 3).
Updating on a hit to way w: make the bits point away from w.
if w[1] = 1: b2 ← not w[0], else b1 ← not w[0]
Only hits update the tree. A miss fills the victim and returns to IDLE, where the repeated
request hits and updates the tree then.
